Ready for the maintainer to merge.

### What looks good

- The new module `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/eye_boot.rs` is small (80 lines) and has a clear provenance comment.
- The thread hand-off uses no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()` outside tests.
- If the worker thread cannot start, `Shell::init_gpu` builds `StockEye` on the UI thread as before.
- If the worker thread stops without a result, `eye_boot::take` returns a named error once and clears the receiver.
- The unit tests in `eye_boot::tests` cover the empty channel, a refusal, a disconnected sender, and `Send` for `StockEye`.
- The PR matches the browser shell path (`shell_web.rs`) and records the trade-offs in `docs/decisions/3583-stock-eye-async.md`.
- No visual UI layout or widget changed, so before/after screenshots do not apply. The body gives the before/after startup timings.

### Results merged with main

I built and tested this PR locally on Linux in `.claude/worktrees/review-3585`, merged cleanly with `upstream/main` (`b5ef7c39e`).

### Extra suites run

None applicable. The diff does not change `testdata/`, fixtures, importers, posts, operations, motion, or catalog files.

### Requested before merge

None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window/frame.rs` is now 436 lines (+11 lines; it was already above the 400-line target). `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs` is 404 lines (+7 lines).
- `Shell::shutdown` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell_window.rs:346`) does not clear `self.eye_rx`. The field drops right after `shutdown` returns, and `file_dialog::PARENT` holds an `Arc<Window>` on the main thread until `std::process::exit`. You can clear `self.eye_rx = None` in `shutdown` as a small cleanup. You can also wake the loop with `EventLoopProxy<()>` instead of cloning `Arc<Window>`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
